Lake-ice conditions and any safety requirements were not checked, and the group's destination was not answered, so this is a proposal only. Check current ice and trail status with the local club and the Québec snowmobile federation before relying on it; that check is the clearance, not this text.

candidatesAccepted.title: Trail-access pass for the rented snowmobiles
candidatesAccepted.summary: Groomed-trail riding in Québec generally needs a trail-access pass, which is worth sorting before anything else. I have not checked current prices or validity dates, and I do not know the destination, the riders' ages, access needs or rule-outs, so treat this as a starting point to verify.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental snowmobile fleet with helmets and winter gear
candidatesAccepted.summary: A local rental fleet suits the rental-machine arrangement and a groomed-trail preference. I have not checked availability, insurance terms or rider-experience requirements, and two of the four riders are new, so a briefing on handling is worth asking for.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental damage and travel insurance check before departure
candidatesAccepted.summary: Confirm the rental damage deductible, theft terms and whether existing travel or health cover applies to motorised winter riding. I have not read any policies, so this is a question to answer with the rental provider and your insurer, not a confirmation of cover.

gaps.detail: This part of the plan was left out to keep the run inside its budget. Re-planning with a larger budget would fill it in.
Nothing was checked about where to eat.
